newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fiyta 96 net profits fall 8.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fiyta 96 net profits fall 8.3 pct.

text.p: Year ended December 31, 1996 (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.465 yuan vs 0.64 yuan
Net assets per share 2.52 yuan vs 2.22 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd .

NOTE: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards except for the net profit figures which are based on international accounting standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 64.42 million yuan for 1996 against 70.75 million for 1995.
The company, a watchmaker, proposed a cash payment of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, Fiyta's 1996 annual report said.
Fiyta also proposed a two-for-10 rights offer, tentatively priced at between six and nine yuan per share, to expand production and sales network, it said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
